files.description: List of source file paths to compute hash sums for. Items are strings representing file paths.

algorithm.description: The hash algorithm to use for computing the sum (e.g., sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, sha512, md5, crc32, crc8).

compare_hash.description: Expected hash value to compare against the computed result. Empty string means no comparison.

show_progress.description: If true, show a progress bar during hash computation.

list_algorithms.description: If true, list all available hash algorithms and exit.
